answer_plain: Full solar-panel cover raises hydrogen uptake over two weeks by 17 % (by 0.4 to 52 %), so uptake goes up in every case we tried because reduced evaporation under the panels and water from panel washing keep the sand moist longer than panel shade slows microbial enzymes.
answer_science: Central percentage change: h2_uptake_change_pct = 16.64 % (median 23.44 %, 50 % IQR [13.11, 33.79] %, joint 5–95 % interval [0.3517, 51.83] %) (rounded headline: 17 %); absolute change h2_uptake_contrast_umol_m2 = 183.5 µmol m⁻² (median 175.8 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [54.44, 496.2] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [1.722, 1131] µmol m⁻²); absolute uptake h2_uptake_umol_m2 = 1286 µmol m⁻² (median 1169 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [427.2, 2829] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [150.4, 5590] µmol m⁻²) (mode = variance, refusal fraction = 0.0 %, max level refusal across question = 0.0 %). Top two Sobol' contributors to output variance: retention_b (ST = 0.41 [0.36, 0.45], S1 = 0.26) and solar_panel_evap_reduction_frac (ST = 0.29 [0.25, 0.33], S1 = 0.21). Status share of variance: verified_in_source ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00), modeller_assumption ST = 1.05 (S1 = 1.01), source_not_checked ST = 0.00 (S1 = -0.00) (joint group total indices can sum to more than 1 because of interactions). Limits: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error.

limits_plain: The range shows how much the answer moves when uncertain numbers in the models are varied; the models themselves could also be wrong. Wind shifts under panel rows and runoff strips along panel edges are simplified to an even average.
limits_science: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error. Homogenises under-panel microclimate and wash-water drips spatially; competing cooling (Q10) and moisture-retention effects partially offset each other across parameter draws.
